name: Vyshyvanka embroidered shirt
about: A traditional Ukrainian embroidered shirt. Its patterns carry regional folk designs, which makes it a classic Kyiv souvenir.
tip: Check whether the embroidery is hand-stitched or machine-made, since the price difference is large. Confirm the shop is open before you go.

name: Petrykivka painting
where: Vsi. Svoi home and decor shops, Respublika Park
about: Petrykivka is a Ukrainian decorative painting style with colorful floral patterns. It is a well-known folk craft of central Ukraine and is sold widely in Kyiv.
tip: Stock and opening days vary, so ask the shop about availability and hours before visiting.

name: Roshen chocolate
about: Roshen is one of Ukraine's best-known confectionery brands. Its chocolates are a popular and easy gift to bring home from Kyiv.
